title: External actuator approval resume needs persisted control-path simulation
summary: Validate human-to-headless resume with real approval and execution stores while replacing only final transports.
hint_triggers: Exercise actual actuator admission, persisted approval decisions, the pipeline journal and durable execution reservations. Assert zero external calls before approval, one after approval, no extra calls on replay, and zero model repair after an ambiguous effect. Review artifact references participate in approval payload binding and must remain deterministic when interactive execution resumes headlessly. Preserve consent, tenant and delegated-execution floors independently. A simulated process launch validates reentry binding, not an OS subprocess restart or live provider behavior.
